quotes.text: A saved Review with `status: error`, the capacity message, and a matching Review checkout `currentHash` can retry safely only by calling `runCodexReview` with the full prompt and `task: "review"`; reopening/polling the failed turn only replays history. Launch the console from the Thunderbird root, not `Commands checkout`, so Working/Review checkout discovery is correct. [Task 7]
